cohort: The study included 485 cases of attempted suicide and 350 cases of completed suicide, each matched with ten controls, identified among women in Taiwan who experienced a stillbirth, miscarriage, termination of pregnancy, or live birth between 2001-2011.
finding: Women who experienced a stillbirth, miscarriage, or termination of pregnancy had significantly increased risks of attempted and completed suicide within 1 year postnatally compared to those who had a live birth.
